summary.text: Sam Harless is a State Representative in the Texas House and has been a resident of Northwest Harris County since 1976. His official biography says that in the 88th Session House Speaker Dade Phelan picked him to chair the Select Committee on Health Care Reform, as well as Homeland Public Safety and other committees.

paragraphs.text: Harless graduated from Spring High School in 1981 and attended Lone Star College before Sam Houston State University.
He and his wife, Patricia, own Fred Fincher Motors, a second-generation independent automobile dealership.
He has served on the Harris County Constable's Precinct 4 Training Advisory Board and the Harris County Sheriff Training Advisory Board, and serves on the board of Lone Star College.
He married Patricia Fincher in 1985; she served in the Texas House from 2007 to 2016 representing the same district.
